meta_description: Manchester Painters specialises in interior and exterior decorating across Manchester. Free quotes, professional finish, local team. Call 07450 374294 today.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior decorating that transforms your Manchester home. Free quote within 24 hours.
services_heading: Complete Painting and Decorating Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: From feature walls to full exterior repaints, we handle every job with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Decorating
services.desc: Fresh paint, wallpaper, and feature walls that breathe new life into your living spaces. We protect your furniture and leave minimal mess.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes for your home's woodwork, brickwork, and fascias. We use premium paints designed for Manchester's climate.

services.title: Woodwork Refurbishment
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, and window frames restored and repainted to factory finish. Includes prep, undercoat, and top coat in your chosen colour.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Offices, shops, and light industrial units refreshed quickly and professionally. We work flexible hours to minimise business disruption.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Precise hanging of contemporary and traditional wallpapers. We match patterns, remove old paper, and prepare walls for a flawless finish.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Textured coatings, glazing, and bespoke colour mixing. Ideal for period properties or creating a unique interior look.

about_pullquote: We treat every job as if it's our own home. No shortcuts.
about_para_1: Manchester Painters was founded on a simple idea: give homeowners honest, reliable decorating at fair prices. Over 18 years, we've built our reputation on returning calls on time, turning up when we say we will, and delivering finishes that last. Our team knows Manchester inside out—we've painted hundreds of homes across Chorlton, Didsbury, Withington, and beyond.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is attention to detail. We prep surfaces properly, use premium paints matched to your vision, and leave your home spotless. Repeat customers make up over 60% of our work—that's not by accident. When you ring us, you'll speak to the owner, not a call centre.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the lounge and hallway done. The lads turned up on time, got on with it, and the place looked immaculate when they'd finished. No fuss, no mess left behind. Will definitely have them back for the bedrooms next year.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant. Got a free quote from Mark within a day, price was fair, and the work was excellent. He stripped all the old paper, made good the walls, and hung new wallpaper perfectly. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: Claire T.

reviews.text: Our front fascia and soffits were looking tired. These guys came out, gave us a sensible quote, and did a top-quality job. Professional throughout. Highly recommend if you're after decorators in Manchester.
reviews.author: Robert H.
